text: The keep rule is a point-estimate gate at n=111: exact 95 pct CI for 106/111 is [89.8,98.5], for 105/111 [88.6,98.0]; adopt and keep-cli are statistically indistinguishable. Trustworthy outcome needs a pre-committed stability margin or an explicit indistinguishable outcome.
The judge compares round1 percentages, not counts: a true 94.96 pct would pass as 95.0. At K=111 no k/111 lands in the gap, but a larger replay can. Use raw agreeing/measured counts.
The latency pair is recorded-vs-fresh and the report does not say so; the --pi --cli both-sides path records replay:'fresh' under one clock and has never run.
cost_per_100 is unverifiable from the run's records: it reads in-process usage.cost.total and no usage is stored in calls.jsonl.

Input drift between recording and replay is undetectable: the plan verifies only the option key set, Pi is sent the current census prompt, the CLI answers were recorded against the then-current prompt, and neither side stores a comparable prompt digest.
Identity pinning is one-sided: the CLI gate pins jev 0.6.2 exactly and skips on mismatch, the Pi gate resolves any version with no check while the verdict holds for Pi 0.99.1.
There is no repeat-run evidence: one run only, no seed/temperature control, no drift estimate; two more replays would bound run-to-run variance for ~$0.015 and ~3 minutes.

Agreement is not accuracy: no gold labels exist for the 019 corpus, so the five flips prove difference, not correctness; the 12-row sub-0.10-margin pool is the highest-value place for a labeled subset.

Report stores none of the metric artifacts (no per-row margins, tie flags or order-level picks), so a reader cannot tell an artifact flip from a behavior flip; the reported agreement shifts 95.2 to 95.5 across defensible rules.

Record-completeness gaps: timeout records status with no skip line; jev exits outside {0,2,3,130} record unmeasured with no line; report has excluded count but no ids; instrumented callers write backend jev even when Pi answered.
The coverage denominator is sound: K=plan.size+excluded.length keeps rebuild-excluded rows as unmeasured (excluded=0 here); only auditability of the excluded set is missing.
